title: [GMCP 203.015.04] Adversarial and failure behavior: MCP Apps extension and secure interactive UI
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-015-04. Close validation, authorization, isolation, privacy, bounded-resource, cancellation, concurrency, crash, retry, rollback, and recovery behavior. Add deterministic negative, attack, race, corruption, and fault-injection fixtures derived from the vector threat model. Vector outcome: GMCP hosts and consumes the stable MCP Apps extension end to end: resources and tool results can declare trusted UI metadata, render in a sandboxed surface, call permitted tools, update state, and degrade to accessible non-visual content. CSP, origin isolation, permissions, accessibility, lifecycle, version negotiation, hostile app content and cross-app data separation pass the official extension suite and browser security tests. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
